description: Database, schema/table, PostgreSQL load, container resources, Docker engine storage, and authoritative host-volume capacity telemetry.

options.content:
## Storage growth decisions
**Physical free space is the capacity authority.** Database/relation bytes explain part of that use; never add them to filesystem used bytes. Retained migration copies are not reclaimable space until explicitly retired.

Native SSD/HDD panels below compare two fresh **2-minute windows, 24 hours apart**, matched by resource, filesystem UUID, device and size. They show net physical growth and a linear planning estimate to the existing **85% usage alert**, not the storage policy reserve or permission to run maintenance. Negative projected days mean the threshold is already exceeded. Flat/falling growth, missing UUID/history or unhealthy telemetry produces no runway estimate—not infinite capacity. Shared-device resources must not be added together.

Database snapshots: **5-minute cadence / 30-day retention**. Filesystem telemetry: **15-second cadence / 7-day Loki retention**. Top relations include indexes and TOAST; sizes and row estimates do not establish compression, reclaimability or future growth.

Existing alerts: **70% warning / 85% critical / 92% emergency**, plus missing/failed physical telemetry. They notify only. Use the storage capacity plan before changing placement, retention or hardware.

targets.expr: ((max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m] offset 24h)) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m])))) and on (resource_id) (min by (resource_id) (min_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="storage_health" | physical_host_visible="true" | keep resource_id, available | unwrap available | __error__="" [2m])) > 0)

panels.title: Native storage: 24h net growth
panels.description: Net loss of physical available bytes between fresh endpoint windows 24h apart, including all users of that filesystem. Negative means net space gained; this is not a sustained growth guarantee.

targets.expr: ((0.85 * (max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m])) + max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) / ((max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m] offset 24h)) - max by (resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | physical_host_visible="true" | filesystem_uuid!="" | keep resource_id, filesystem_uuid, device_id, total_bytes, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))) > 0)) and on (resource_id) (min by (resource_id) (min_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="storage_health" | physical_host_visible="true" | keep resource_id, available | unwrap available | __error__="" [2m])) > 0)

panels.title: Native storage: days to 85% used
panels.description: Linear planning estimate to the existing 85% usage alert from positive 24h physical growth. Negative means already above the threshold. Missing, flat or falling growth is not infinite runway. This is not the policy reserve, a two-year forecast, or maintenance admission.

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' - max(sampled_at)))::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples;

panels.title: Database capacity sample age
panels.description: Age of the latest database sample, independent of the selected historical range. Expected cadence is 300 seconds. Color bands show two/three missed cadences, not a storage capacity decision.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sampled_at AS time, database_size_bytes::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

WITH p AS (SELECT sampled_at,database_size_bytes FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)), b AS (SELECT min(sampled_at) first_at,max(sampled_at) last_at FROM p), v AS (SELECT (SELECT database_size_bytes FROM p ORDER BY sampled_at LIMIT 1) first_bytes,(SELECT database_size_bytes FROM p ORDER BY sampled_at DESC LIMIT 1) last_bytes) SELECT b.last_at AS time,CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.last_at-b.first_at))>0 THEN (v.last_bytes-v.first_bytes)::double precision/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.last_at-b.first_at)) ELSE 0 END value FROM b CROSS JOIN v;

WITH l AS (SELECT max(sampled_at) sampled_at FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)) SELECT l.sampled_at AS time,COALESCE(sum(s.total_bytes),0)::double precision value FROM l LEFT JOIN observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples s ON s.sampled_at=l.sampled_at AND s.schema_name='market' GROUP BY l.sampled_at;

targets.expr: max by (resource_id, capacity_authority) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, capacity_authority, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))

panels.title: Storage filesystem free (by resource and authority)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sampled_at AS time,database_size_bytes::double precision AS database FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name AS metric,sum(total_bytes)::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' GROUP BY sampled_at,schema_name ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,total_bytes::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,estimated_live_rows::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY sampled_at;

WITH l AS (SELECT max(sampled_at) sampled_at FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)) SELECT s.schema_name,s.relation_name,s.relation_kind,pg_size_pretty(s.total_bytes) total,pg_size_pretty(s.table_bytes) table_data,pg_size_pretty(s.index_bytes) indexes,pg_size_pretty(s.toast_bytes) toast,s.estimated_live_rows,s.estimated_dead_rows FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples s JOIN l USING(sampled_at) WHERE s.schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND s.relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}' ORDER BY s.total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Largest logical relations now
panels.description: Total includes table, indexes and TOAST. Estimated rows are not exact bytes-per-Fact measurements; retained migration namespaces are not automatically reclaimable.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}'), f AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(schema_name,relation_name) schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at,total_bytes,estimated_live_rows FROM s ORDER BY schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at), l AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(schema_name,relation_name) schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at,total_bytes,estimated_live_rows FROM s ORDER BY schema_name,relation_name,sampled_at DESC) SELECT l.schema_name,l.relation_name,pg_size_pretty(l.total_bytes) current_size,pg_size_pretty(l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes) growth,l.estimated_live_rows-f.estimated_live_rows row_growth,ROUND(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(l.sampled_at-f.sampled_at))>0 THEN (l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes)::numeric/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(l.sampled_at-f.sampled_at)) ELSE 0 END,2) bytes_per_second FROM l JOIN f USING(schema_name,relation_name) ORDER BY l.total_bytes-f.total_bytes DESC LIMIT 50;

WITH p AS (SELECT sampled_at,schema_name,relation_name,inserts_total,lag(sampled_at) OVER(PARTITION BY schema_name,relation_name ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_at,lag(inserts_total) OVER(PARTITION BY schema_name,relation_name ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_inserts FROM observability_metrics.database_relation_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) AND schema_name ~ '${schema:regex}' AND relation_name ~ '${relation:regex}') SELECT sampled_at AS time,schema_name||'.'||relation_name AS metric,CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at))>0 THEN GREATEST(inserts_total-previous_inserts,0)::double precision/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at)) ELSE 0 END value FROM p WHERE previous_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sampled_at;

WITH p AS (SELECT sampled_at,wal_bytes,lag(sampled_at) OVER(ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_at,lag(wal_bytes) OVER(ORDER BY sampled_at) previous_bytes FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at)) SELECT sampled_at AS time,CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at))>0 THEN GREATEST(wal_bytes-previous_bytes,0)::double precision/EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM(sampled_at-previous_at)) ELSE 0 END value FROM p WHERE previous_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,connections_total::double precision AS total,connections_active::double precision AS active,connections_idle::double precision AS idle,max_connections::double precision AS maximum FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

SELECT sampled_at AS time,CASE WHEN blocks_hit+blocks_read>0 THEN 100.0*blocks_hit::double precision/(blocks_hit+blocks_read) ELSE 100.0 END value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;

targets.expr: avg_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="container" | container_name=~"${container:regex}" | unwrap cpu_percent [$__interval]) by (container_name)
avg_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="container" | container_name=~"${container:regex}" | unwrap memory_percent [$__interval]) by (container_name)
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, used_bytes | unwrap used_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, available_bytes | unwrap available_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))
max by (resource_id) (last_over_time({compose_service="docker-stats"} | json | sample_kind="filesystem" | keep resource_id, total_bytes | unwrap total_bytes | __error__="" [2m]))

targets.rawSql: SELECT sampled_at AS time,sample_query_ms::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;
SELECT sampled_at AS time,relation_count::double precision AS value FROM observability_metrics.database_capacity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(sampled_at) ORDER BY sampled_at;
